notes: Repair flickering town surfaces where roads, plazas, paths and loading bays overlap. Restore reliable shared-town synchronization and voice traffic with corrected server bandwidth and compressed ENet packets. Includes all Shared Societies features: six Earth/Moon towns, farming, finite trade, town claims, working neighbors, physical deliveries and optional tutorials. E opens the nearby person or workplace; B opens your journal. Apply the signed update and restart, or install the full package. Every client and the public server must use 0.6.1 / protocol 13. Bootstrap 3 is retained; installations older than 0.4.10 need the full installer. Existing saves are preserved.
